text: International economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that focuses on global economic activities, cross-border trade rules, and the operation of international markets, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, management, law, and sociology. Its core objective is to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective, who master the theories and practical operations of international trade and are familiar with international economic rules. They can engage in international trade business, cross-border investment, international market analysis and other work in scenarios such as multinational enterprises, government agencies and financial organizations.
